PICK ONE OF THESE THREE — they are the whole decision.

A · Field Guide — cream paper, huge serif, data set like a printed reference. Calm and authoritative.
B · Instrument — dark, measurement bars, one lime signal colour. The data is the interface.
C · Grocer — flat colour blocks, oversized italic, no shadows. Warm and loud, food first.

Below: direction A built out across all six page types, so you can judge it as a system rather than one hero.
Say B or C instead and I rebuild these six in that language.
